headline: Indian Economy Demonstrates Resilience While Jindal Steel and Alembic Pharma Announce Key Developments

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: RBI bulletin notes Indian economy stands out positively despite uneven global performance.
Jindal Steel targets ₹15,000 crore investment by 2035 focusing on coated steel.
Alembic Pharma secured U.S. FDA approval for an additional strength of a cancer drug.
RBI highlights ongoing broad-based pressure on food prices.
whatHappening: Jindal Steel outlined a long-term capital investment plan of ₹15,000 crore targeting coated steel.
Alembic Pharma received US FDA clearance for another strength of its cancer treatment medication.
RBI Bulletin reported strong economic standing for India amidst global economic uncertainty.
IRDAI health panel established two study groups aimed at enhancing claim transparency.
summary: India's economy continues to stand out resiliently amid uneven global performance, as highlighted in the latest RBI bulletin. In corporate news, Jindal Steel is eyeing a ₹15,000 crore investment by 2035 targeting coated steel production. Additionally, Alembic Pharma received US FDA approval for an additional strength of its cancer drug.
